falsification_conditions: Provide Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) documentation and characterization reports for the SGL‑001 source cell line (sterility, identity, adventitious agent testing, stability, cryopreservation records).

Submit defined orthogonal QC panel SOPs and validation reports for intact‑EV assays (particle count/size, protein and lipid EV markers, non‑vesicular particle markers) demonstrating analytical performance: LLOQ, specificity (ability to distinguish intact EVs from free cargo/non‑vesicular particles), accuracy, precision, and robustness.

Provide batch manufacturing records and batch reports for  or more GMP‑like production runs including in‑process controls, release testing, stability results, potency results, and comparability analyses demonstrating reproducible CQAs across lots (with variability metrics).

strongest_objection: The reviewer conclusions rely on MISEV2023 as a consensus standard but lack any program-specific experimental/CMC/assay/batch data; therefore the core assertion that SGL-001 meets (or is ready to meet) the specified MCB/WCB, validated intact‑EV assays, stability‑indicating potency, and reproducible GMP‑like production criteria is unproven and remains an unsupported inference from guidance rather than demonstrated fact.
